name: All Around the Coffee Shop
source:
Take on the role of Caesar in this peculiar little game and try to survive your day-to-day work at Rocket's cafe "Apes strong. Coffee stronger!"

[From [url=https://squickqueen.itch.io/coffeeapes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款奇特的小游戏中扮演凯撒的角色，并努力在火箭咖啡馆“猿猴强。咖啡更强！”的日常工作中生存下来。

[来自[url=https://squickqueen.itch.io/coffeeapes]Itch.io[/url]]
